oil.when: 2010 (maintenance light reset with the trip meter button)
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
With the ignition ON, press the trip meter button until the display shows trip meter A.
Turn the key off.
Hold the trip meter reset button down while you turn the key back to ON. Do not start the engine.
Keep holding until the trip meter reads 000000, then let go.

tpms.when: 2016 with the tire pressure warning reset (SET) switch on the instrument panel
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Park and turn the ignition to ON.
Find the tire pressure warning reset switch, marked SET, on the instrument panel. The dash diagram in the owner's manual shows where it is.
Press and hold the SET switch until the tire pressure light blinks 3 times, then let go.
Leave the car sitting for a few minutes so the system can finish setting up.
tpms.note: If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault. A reset will not clear it; have it checked.

tpms.when: 2019 Corolla sedan with the tire pressure warning reset (SET) button (not the 2019 Corolla Hatchback)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Park and turn the ignition to ON.
Press and hold the SET button until the tire pressure light blinks 3 times, then let go.
Wait a few minutes so the system can finish setting up.
tpms.note: If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault. A reset will not clear it; have it checked. Checked in the 2019 Corolla Quick Reference Guide.

tpms.when: 2020–2022 Corolla sedan, Corolla Hybrid and Corolla Hatchback, set from Vehicle Settings in the multi-information display
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Park and turn the vehicle on.
Use the steering wheel switches for the multi-information display to move to the screen that lists Vehicle Settings.
Select Vehicle Settings and open it.
Select TPWS and open it.
Select Set Pressure, then press and hold the select switch until the tire pressure light blinks 3 times.
tpms.note: If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault. A reset will not clear it; have it checked. Checked in the 2020 Corolla Hybrid and 2022 Corolla Hatchback Quick Reference Guides.

tpms.when: 2023–2024 Corolla, Corolla Hybrid and Corolla Hatchback, with the Tire Pressure Setting menu in the multi-information display
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Park and turn the vehicle on.
Use the steering wheel switches for the multi-information display to move to the screen that lists Vehicle Settings (the icon differs between the 4.2-inch and 7-inch displays).
Select Vehicle Settings, then press and hold the select switch to open it.
Select TPWS, then Tire Pressure Setting.
Choose Setting by Specified Pressure and pick the pressures, or choose Setting by Current Pressure, then confirm.
A message shows that the pressure is being set, and the tire pressure light blinks slowly 3 times.
tpms.note: If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault. A reset will not clear it; have it checked. Checked in the 2023 Corolla Hatchback and 2024 Corolla / Corolla Hybrid Quick Reference Guides.
